mappings.name: seeds-from-a-read

originalInput.name: seeds-from-a-read
originalInput.covers: The controller reads the Info dict once when the document connects and sets it; getSnapshot() is null until then.

mappings.partialRetirement: Eager connect-time metadata.read is removed by onDemand; preserve null/in-flight/loaded values via explicit ensureLoaded. Combined custom keys load independently through custom.get.
mappings.retainedIntent: Opening and synchronous getters do no reads. ensureLoaded starts both reads, keeps snapshots null until settled, and emits resynced separately.

mappings.name: a-failed-seed-read-is-ignored

originalInput.name: a-failed-seed-read-is-ignored
originalInput.covers: A read that rejects (a closed document, an aborted read) leaves the state null and reports nothing.

mappings.partialRetirement: Background eager read with swallowed rejection retires: explicit ensureLoaded rejects its caller; no reports, null/error metadata, independent ready custom mirror survive.
mappings.retainedIntent: An on-demand read failure rejects its caller, leaves null metadata/error status, and reports nothing; custom success stays ready.

mappings.name: live-updates-from-the-event-stream

originalInput.name: live-updates-from-the-event-stream
originalInput.covers: A metadata.updated event, own or remote, replaces the state with the metadata it carries; any other event is ignored; closing the document unsubscribes.

mappings.retainedIntent: Both origins fold confirmed standard/custom facts. Unrelated facts are ignored; close releases the instance and reopen begins idle.

mappings.name: update-writes-through-and-sets

originalInput.name: update-writes-through-and-sets
originalInput.covers: update(patch) sends the three-state patch to the engine and resolves with its result once the confirmed metadata.updated event has set the snapshot.

mappings.partialRetirement: Public result drops old cache:null and returns {metadata}; full MutationMeta stays at engine boundary. Confirmed-event-before-resolution and exact three-state patch survive.
mappings.retainedIntent: The three-state standard patch reaches the engine unchanged. Only its confirmed event changes the mirror, before the structured write result settles.

mappings.name: update-refused

originalInput.name: update-refused
originalInput.covers: An engine refusal rejects update() with the engine error and changes nothing.

mappings.retainedIntent: An engine refusal rejects update and preserves the complete ready snapshots.

mappings.name: reload

originalInput.name: reload
originalInput.covers: refresh() re-reads and sets; a failed refresh rejects.

mappings.partialRetirement: Automatic first read is replaced by explicit ensureLoaded. Failed refresh now retains last confirmed data with error status; standard refresh does not reload custom.
mappings.retainedIntent: refresh re-reads only the standard mirror; a failed refresh rejects and leaves its last value with error status.

mappings.name: can-edit

originalInput.name: can-edit
originalInput.covers: canEdit() is the doc.metadata.modify authority, wildcard included.

mappings.retainedIntent: canUpdate is the doc.metadata.modify authority for both write surfaces, wildcard included, without loading.

mappings.name: update-without-the-capability-is-refused-locally

originalInput.name: update-without-the-capability-is-refused-locally
originalInput.covers: Without doc.metadata.modify, update() rejects with a permission-denied PluginError before it reaches the engine, and the snapshot and status stay as they were.

mappings.retainedIntent: Both writes reject permission-denied before any engine write and preserve snapshots/status.

mappings.name: a-forbidden-seed-read

originalInput.name: a-forbidden-seed-read
originalInput.covers: A seed read the engine refuses with PermissionDenied leaves the snapshot null and the status forbidden; a later plain failure makes it error, and a good refresh makes it ready.

mappings.partialRetirement: Eager first read retires; explicit ensureLoaded rejects. PermissionDenied now carries real Forbidden/details.required, preserving forbidden/error/ready sequence.
mappings.retainedIntent: An explicit first load may be forbidden; plain refresh failure is error; a later successful refresh recovers ready.

mappings.name: status-while-the-seed-read-is-in-flight

originalInput.name: status-while-the-seed-read-is-in-flight
originalInput.covers: The status is loading while the seed read is out, and a refresh made meanwhile shares that read instead of issuing a second one.

mappings.partialRetirement: Eager loading retires; open is idle. ensureLoaded joins both in-flight reads; current explicit refresh queues one standard re-read rather than deduplicating that request.
mappings.retainedIntent: Loading is explicit. Concurrent ensureLoaded shares both reads; refresh joins the promise and queues one standard re-read.

mappings.name: an-event-during-the-seed-read-wins

originalInput.name: an-event-during-the-seed-read-wins
originalInput.covers: A confirmed metadata.updated that lands while the seed read is out is newer than that read, so the read is dropped when it arrives.

mappings.partialRetirement: Eager connect read retires; same event-wins race begins via ensureLoaded and now covers both standard/custom mirrors.
mappings.retainedIntent: New standard and custom confirmed values win over both older in-flight load answers.

mappings.name: closing-during-the-seed-read

originalInput.name: closing-during-the-seed-read
originalInput.covers: Closing the document while its seed read is out ends that read as instance-closed, which the controller swallows: nothing is reported.

mappings.partialRetirement: Eager connect read retires; explicit load is ended at close, with mirror instance-close suppression and no late load callbacks. Add reopen idle witnesses.
mappings.retainedIntent: Close cancels the explicit load, suppresses late results/callbacks, and reopen starts with fresh idle mirrors.

mappings.name: on-updated-reports-each-confirmed-change

originalInput.name: on-updated-reports-each-confirmed-change
originalInput.covers: onUpdated fires once per confirmed value, after the snapshot changed: the seed read with every key and a system origin, then each event with its previous value, the keys that differ (custom by its JSON, so reordered entries count) and the origin the event carried. After unsubscribing it stays quiet.

mappings.partialRetirement: Loads no longer emit updated/system origin; onResynced carries load values separately. Custom JSON-order comparisons retire to independent shallow custom keys; malformed sparse standard input is completed to current DTO.
mappings.retainedIntent: Loads emit resynced; facts emit updated with full previous/changedKeys/origin. Custom key reordering compares equal; unsubscribing silences listeners.

mappings.name: changed-keys-beyond-the-info-dict

originalInput.name: changed-keys-beyond-the-info-dict
originalInput.covers: changedKeys compares every key but custom with !==: an equal number is unchanged and a different one changed, while an object or array member always counts as changed, even with the same contents.
originalInput.reason: Pins changedKeys' comparison rules, through its returned value. Its dispatched actions are compared; the state they build is not.

mappings.partialRetirement: Arbitrary number/object/array fields are outside current DocumentMetadata/CustomMetadata DTO. Preserve equal/different-key intent as typed custom strings; object identity and JSON custom-order behavior retire under a4b8259f7 model/DTO evidence.
mappings.retainedIntent: Custom keys are flat strings; shallow comparison records changed, added and removed keys and ignores equal/reordered entries.

additions.name: custom-write-confirms-before-settlement
additions.purpose: Custom patches set, clear and omit independently of standard fields; deferred engine confirmation fires before the returned result settles.

additions.name: standard-write-does-not-project-unconfirmed-result
additions.purpose: A returned engine value alone does not update the mirror; only a confirmed fact does.

additions.name: custom-refresh-and-refusal
additions.purpose: Custom refresh and engine write refusal leave the standard mirror intact.
